scenario.title: Acquiring a SaaS startup
scenario.description: You want to acquire a profitable SaaS startup. Independent valuation puts fair value around $9M. The seller has just opened at $13M.

results.reasoning: I initiate slam exploration with an aggressive bid, signaling my strong interest and setting the stage for a big deal.
I prefer a sure small gain over a risky large one, and this offer secures a safe partscore.
Their opening bid is an overreach; I'm making a strong penalty double to anchor the negotiation and maximize my score.
Aggressively establishing our preferred balanced contract early, much like an NT overcall, to find a stable deal.
A standard counter-offer based on fair valuation, setting a reasonable baseline for negotiation.
